# Paper-local TeX compatibility files

The host uses TeX Live 2017, while the paper source uses a newer package
feature. This directory vendors the generated `.sty` file for:

- `enumitem` from CTAN (`macros/latex/contrib/enumitem`), MIT.

It is included only to make the unchanged official ICLR 2027 source
reproducible on this machine. Distribution remains governed by each package's
upstream license.
